question: What are two requirements when planning a Cisco HyperFlex All Flash standard cluster installation using three Cisco HX240c M5 Series servers? (Choose two.)
options: If the Jumbo MTU option in the HyperFlex installer is enabled, then jumbo frames do not have to be enabled on the upstream switches.
This cluster deployment type must support a mix of HDD and SSD.
The servers must be discovered, unassociated, and connected to each fabric interconnect.
If the Jumbo MTU option in the HyperFlex installer is enabled, then jumbo frames must also be enabled on the upstream switches.
The hypervisors must be installed to Cisco FlexFlash SD cards.
theory: Before HyperFlex installer software can build a standard All-Flash cluster, the target HX240c M5 servers must already be discovered by UCS Manager, left unassociated (no service profile yet, since the installer creates those), and physically connected to both fabric interconnects for redundant connectivity. Separately, jumbo frames are an end-to-end setting: if the installer's Jumbo MTU option is turned on for the HyperFlex data network, the upstream switches must also be configured for jumbo frames, otherwise fragmentation or dropped frames will occur along the path — the installer setting alone is not sufficient. (CCNP/CCIE DCCOR Official Cert Guide, Chapter 15 — HyperFlex All-Flash Cluster Installation Prerequisites)
